item5_1_receipt_emission.null_convention: short-circuited/unreached predicate stages (hex310/hex311/onto/reduction_match) are emitted as JSON null (via DCP3BoolOrNull, which maps GAP's `fail` sentinel to the literal string "null", never JB(false)) -- verdict itself is ALWAYS a real boolean (false whenever any stage failed or was unreached, true only on a genuine full pass), matching the coordinator's spec exactly.

item5_2_checker_v3.word_based_reevaluation_retired: confirmed per instruction -- theta~/tau~ are re-derived via a HOMOMORPHISM-TRACKED, degree-bounded stabilizer chain over G=<JX,JY> (build_hom_tracked_chain/apply_hom): orbit and Schreier-generator construction carries, in parallel with each transversal permutation, its own image under the target homomorphism (theta: JX->JY,JY->JX ; tau: JX->JY,JY->JY^-1 JX^-1 JC), computed via the group's OWN multiplication (not a separately-chosen word representative). This is the 'reconstruction via group elements' the coordinator asked for, extending v2's CK-1 technique (already used for DerivedSubgroup) to arbitrary-homomorphism evaluation.

self_caught_bug_during_this_pass.description: the FIRST implementation of apply_hom() accumulated the homomorphism image in the WRONG order (forward: phi(u_1)*phi(u_2)*...*phi(u_k)) instead of the order the sift procedure's algebra actually requires (reversed: phi(u_k)*...*phi(u_2)*phi(u_1), derived from p*u_1^-1*u_2^-1*...*u_k^-1=identity => p=u_k*...*u_1). This produced a systematic HEX310_MISMATCH on ALL 10 initial test receipts (recomputed=False, producer=True, uniformly) -- caught immediately by round-tripping against known-good producer output, fixed by reversing the accumulation (img_acc := pmul(u_img, img_acc), prepend not append), and re-verified to PASS on all 10 receipts afterward.
self_caught_bug_during_this_pass.significance: this is reported transparently because it IS structurally the same class of order-convention error WDICT-5 itself was -- caught this time by the very round-trip discipline (producer output vs independent checker) this whole repair campaign exists to enforce, rather than by an external falsifier. Left as an explicit demonstration that the discipline works, not smoothed over.
